entries.dialogueText: "What have we captured so far?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Tell me about public opinion back home. What do Rizians think about the war?"

entries.dialogueText: "Our intelligence reports indicate that the enemy has taken mass casualties."

entries.dialogueText: "Our intelligence reports indicate that the enemy has taken many casualties."

entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately, the Palesians are tougher than we expected."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "They are tough, but so are we."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Honestly, even I didn't think it would be this easy."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""They're dropping like flies, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're dropping like flies, Your Majesty. Left and right."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "We have taken Arces and Ziqes. New forward operating bases have been set up nearby."

entries.dialogueText: "We have taken Arces. New forward operating bases have been set up nearby."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""ENOUGH, DAMN YOU!""
entries.dialogueText: "ENOUGH, DAMN YOU!"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see. Go on.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see. Go on."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""We have taken Ziqes. New forward o..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have taken Ziqes. New forward operating bases have been set up nearby."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "Regretfully, we have yet to capture any of our main operation objectives."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "With great sadness, I must also inform you that we have lost control of Terador and Fort Ales."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""With great sadness, I must also in..."
entries.dialogueText: "With great sadness, I must also inform you that we have lost control of Fort Ales."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""With great sadness, I must also in..."
entries.dialogueText: "With great sadness, I must also inform you that we have lost control of Terador."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Despite the heavy fighting, Fort A..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the heavy fighting, Fort Ales and Terador are still under our control."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""A minor setback. I'm confident we'..."
entries.dialogueText: "A minor setback. I'm confident we'll regain the ground we lost."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Our cities persevere.""
entries.dialogueText: "Our cities persevere."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""A sizeable resistance is growing,..."
entries.dialogueText: "A sizeable resistance is growing, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Yes, sire. But all within our expe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, sire. But all within our expectations."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""There doesn't seem to be much of i..."
entries.dialogueText: "There doesn't seem to be much of it. It's as I suspected -- Pales *wants* to rejoin Rizia."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Or we've simply intimidated civili..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or we've simply intimidated civilians into submission. Either way, this works in our favor."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""We're doing everything we can to k..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're doing everything we can to keep it contained."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Nothing that we can't handle.""
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing that we can't handle."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The people are on our side, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "The people are on our side, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""General sentiment seems to be agai..."
entries.dialogueText: "General sentiment seems to be against the war, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But once we have a big win, I thin..."
entries.dialogueText: "But once we have a big win, I think the tide will change."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And the more we keep winning, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the more we keep winning, the more their sympathies will increase."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Their strength keeps us strong. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their strength keeps us strong. We will not lose."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The room fell silent. Lucita spoke..."
entries.dialogueText: The room fell silent. Lucita spoke after a few long seconds.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""If you please, Your Majesty, we ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you please, Your Majesty, we need more manpower and equipment."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""This might be the only way we can..."
entries.dialogueText: "This might be the only way we can regain our footing."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""We've achieved promising results,..."
entries.dialogueText: "We've achieved promising results, but we are not done yet."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Precisely. Our manpower is dwindli..."
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely. Our manpower is dwindling. New recruits would provide valuable support."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Precisely. Additional recruits wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely. Additional recruits would provide valuable support."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: "And of course, these troops will re..."
entries.dialogueText: And of course, these troops will require more ammunition and weapons. Our operation has nearly depleted our supply."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""And of course, these troops will r..."
entries.dialogueText: "And of course, these troops will require ammo and weapons. We still have a decent stockpile, but more won't hurt."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Your Majesty, one thing is certain..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, one thing is certain. We can't win this war without able and capable boots on the ground."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will do whatever I can to suppor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will do whatever I can to support the army."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hear you two. You do your part a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hear you two. You do your part and I will do mine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We also can't win this war without..."
entries.dialogueText: "We also can't win this war without able and capable generals."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Thank you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The result of Golden Shield is cle..."
entries.dialogueText: "The result of Golden Shield is clear, Your Majesty. We are on the right path."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was no response."
entries.dialogueText: There was no response.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As these documents outline, the op..."
entries.dialogueText: "As these documents outline, the operation has been a great success."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Before we discuss the next steps,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before we discuss the next steps, we need your seal on the results."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "General Azaro handed me a large scr..."
entries.dialogueText: General Azaro handed me a large scroll and a candle for the wax. I opened it.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I pressed my seal on the wax to app..."
entries.dialogueText: I pressed my seal on the wax to approve.
entries.menuText: Press the seal on the wax.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Thank you, sire.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, sire."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have done well. I am proud of..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have done well. I am proud of all of you. Not only for your exemplary service, but on a personal level."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank *you* for your service to th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank *you* for your service to the crown."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Bring me victory, and only victory.""
entries.dialogueText: "Bring me victory, and only victory."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will not allow any failures. Do..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will not allow any failures. Do you understand?"

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Understood, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Understood, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I serve and obey.""
entries.dialogueText: "I serve and obey."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""That is very touching, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is very touching, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""As do I.""
entries.dialogueText: "As do I."

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Loud and clear.""
entries.dialogueText: "Loud and clear."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Indeed. Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The result of Golden Shield is unf..."
entries.dialogueText: "The result of Golden Shield is unfortunately clear, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""The operation was not a success.""
entries.dialogueText: "The operation was not a success."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Lucita, help me down.""
entries.dialogueText: "Lucita, help me down."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Father -- General, what are you-""
entries.dialogueText: "Father -- General, what are you-"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The old general descended from his..."
entries.dialogueText: The old general descended from his wheelchair and knelt before me, pressing his forehead into the ground.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""My liege. My King. My lord. I have..."
entries.dialogueText: "My liege. My King. My lord. I have failed you."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Do what you will with me. I leave..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do what you will with me. I leave my life at your mercy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Get up, General. A man of your sta..."
entries.dialogueText: "Get up, General. A man of your stature should not humiliate himself like this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you think this will convince me..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you think this will convince me to spare you, you are wrong."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""This war should have been ours to..."
entries.dialogueText: "This war should have been ours to win. I deserve punishment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My mercy? What kind of king do you..."
entries.dialogueText: "My mercy? What kind of king do you think I am?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fix your mess, General. That is al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fix your mess, General. That is all I care about."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He wouldn't budge. Lucita rolled he..."
entries.dialogueText: He wouldn't budge. Lucita rolled her eyes in frustration.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Father. Stop your hysterics and al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father. Stop your hysterics and allow me to help you back into your chair."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Silence, Lucita.""
entries.dialogueText: "Silence, Lucita."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I slapped him in fury. I heard gasp..."
entries.dialogueText: I slapped him in fury. I heard gasps from everyone in the room.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You will receive no punishment. Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will receive no punishment. You will continue working for the Crown. That is all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I walked up to him and ripped the m..."
entries.dialogueText: I walked up to him and ripped the medals off his uniform. I heard gasps from everyone in the room.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""You are too kind to me, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are too kind to me, Your Majesty. But I shall accept and respect your decision."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I accept and respect your punishme..."
entries.dialogueText: "I accept and respect your punishment, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I will redeem myself to you. This..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will redeem myself to you. This I promise in the name of House Azaro."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""So this is my punishment. I have d..."
entries.dialogueText: "So this is my punishment. I have disgraced myself, my family and my kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know that you will.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know that you will."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am bored of this charade. I don'..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am bored of this charade. I don't have all day. Keep going with your briefing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not be so harsh on yourself, Ge..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not be so harsh on yourself, General. It's bad for morale."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""We understand, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "We understand, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Yes, my liege.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, my liege."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Now. It's time for us to talk abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now. It's time for us to talk about our next steps."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita helped him back into his cha..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita helped him back into his chair.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Rom-- Your Majesty! What have you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rom-- Your Majesty! What have you just done?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita turned to me angrily."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita turned to me angrily.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty! What have you just d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty! What have you just done?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Berate me for my failures if you w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Berate me for my failures if you wish. But to disgrace the highest-ranking member of House Azaro?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can and you will. Do not quest..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can and you will. Do not question my authority."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I cannot just sit idly by and take..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot just sit idly by and take this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then make General Taddeus earn his..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then make General Taddeus earn his rank. All I see is failure upon failure."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You dare defy me? Your King?""
entries.dialogueText: "You dare defy me? Your King?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry. You are right. I made a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry. You are right. I made a rash decision."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Please, sire. She did not mean it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please, sire. She did not mean it that way."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Lucita. Apologize to your King thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucita. Apologize to your King this second."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""That problem is mine to handle. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "That problem is mine to handle. I don't need your intervention."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""God. How could you do this to an o..."
entries.dialogueText: "God. How could you do this to an old man? In a wheelchair?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You insulted my father. How am I s..."
entries.dialogueText: "You insulted my father. How am I supposed to react?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I am sorry, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She collected herself and spoke thr..."
entries.dialogueText: She collected herself and spoke through gritted teeth.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I will do what I must to make sure..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will do what I must to make sure we win this war. Leave my father out of it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A long, complete silence followed."
entries.dialogueText: A long, complete silence followed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Listen to your daughter, General.""
entries.dialogueText: "Listen to your daughter, General."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""As you wish, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you wish, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't forget that both of you are..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't forget that both of you are responsible for this failure."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Can we please just move on, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can we please just move on, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled proudly."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled proudly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita drew a breath in through her..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita drew a breath in through her teeth.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's eyes shone brightly."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's eyes shone brightly.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Yes. Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Thank you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She clutched her forehead and took..."
entries.dialogueText: She clutched her forehead and took a deep breath, forcing herself to calm down. Taddeus kept his eyes on the ground.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our troops can still win this, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our troops can still win this, Your Majesty. Just give us a chance."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The old general descended from his..."
entries.dialogueText: The old general descended from his wheelchair and knelt before me, pressing his forehead to the floor.

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""Your words mean a great deal.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your words mean a great deal."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Before I could say anything, Taddeu..."
entries.dialogueText: Before I could say anything, Taddeus turned to Carlos.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Would you excuse us for a moment,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Would you excuse us for a moment, General?"

entries.speaker: Carlos Robles Azaro
entries.title: Carlos Robles Azaro: ""If that is your wish, then certain..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that is your wish, then certainly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He bowed to me and then to Taddeus..."
entries.dialogueText: He bowed to me and then to Taddeus before stepping out of the tent, confused. Taddeus tapped on his daughter's arm.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Carlos was brought back into the ro..."
entries.dialogueText: Carlos was brought back into the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His expression was one of surprise..."
entries.dialogueText: His expression was one of surprise as he glanced between Taddeus and Lucita, as if trying to decipher what had just taken place.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His eyes quickly took in the sight..."
entries.dialogueText: His eyes quickly took in the sight of Taddeus, noting that his medals had been stripped from his jacket -- a clear sign that something had just transpired.

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""House Sazon’s troops are still in..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Sazon’s troops are still in perfect shape and ready to continue the fight."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""House Sazon held their ground and..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Sazon held their ground and made steady gains, though enemy resistance made progress difficult."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""House Sazon’s forces were complete..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Sazon’s forces were completely overrun -- the survivors are either captured or dead."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""House Toras didn't suffer any loss..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Toras didn't suffer any losses, showcasing their efficiency and skill."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""House Toras held the line with fie..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Toras held the line with fierce determination, though advancing proved difficult."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""House Toras was annihilated. There..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Toras was annihilated. There are no reports of survivors from their last position."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""House Azaro’s forces showed remark..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Azaro’s forces showed remarkable coordination, emerging unscathed so far."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""House Azaro inflicted significant..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Azaro inflicted significant damage, but the enemy still holds strategic ground."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""House Azaro’s warriors are no more..."
entries.dialogueText: "House Azaro’s warriors are no more, but they perished as true sons of Rizia -- undaunted, outnumbered, and defiant to their last breath."

entries.dialogueText: "What of our provincial forces?"
